resources.string:
Do I need this app every day?
No. After you Apply knobs once, they live on the buds (survive case/reboot). Day to day: wear both buds and quad-tap to toggle BiCROS. Open this app only to change config or capture a support log.

How do I turn BiCROS on/off without the phone?
Quad-tap either bud (TWS linked). Listen for status cues (chart below).

What do the status beeps / tones mean?
• ENABLED — 1 short beep (~880 Hz) when BiCROS is actually up
• DISABLED — 2 short beeps when you turn it off (or a stock Disconnect tone if audio already stopped)
• NOT YET — stock Warning tone if you enable while teardown/cool-down is still running — wait for READY
• READY — stock Pairing success — safe to enable again
• OPEN FAIL — stock Pairing failed — link did not come up; try again after READY or reseat

Where are my knobs saved?
On both buds in flash NV when you tap Apply. Connect / Get reloads them into the app.

Why can’t I set Poor = Left?
Poor ear must be the TWS slave. Default is Right = poor, Left = good (master). Poor = Left while Left is master → enable is refused (known crash if forced).

What does the phone volume rocker do while BiCROS is on?
It changes CROS path level (contralateral SCO), not music and not local-ear mix. With BiCROS off, the rocker is music again.

Why is Support log off by default?
SPP log traffic can fight the BiCROS link. Leave it off for normal use; turn on only to Share a bug report.

Is this a hearing aid / medical device?
No. Experimental DIY firmware on ~$70 earbuds — own risk. Not prescribed CROS/BiCROS or certified hearing protection.
Dev only — starts phone HFP SCO (not BiCROS). Confuses most users; leave off.

Apply saves to both buds (survives case). Day to day you can leave this app closed — quad-tap toggles BiCROS. Phone rocker while BiCROS is on = CROS path level (not music).

DIY / own-risk — not a hearing aid

PineBuds Pro BiCROS is experimental firmware on consumer earbuds. It is not a medical device, prescribed CROS/BiCROS, or certified hearing protection.

Flash and use only if you can restore stock firmware. Loud levels and feedback (howling) are possible if you bypass the mix ceiling (−12 dB).

Poor ear must stay the TWS slave (default: Right poor / Left master).

This app is only for configuration and optional support logging. After you Apply knobs once, you do not need the app for day-to-day use — quad-tap the buds to toggle BiCROS.
